Hi Markus / Ben,

Thanks again for walking us through the redlines last week. Our legal team finished a quick internal run and we have three execution logistics asks before we can proceed with signatures:

1) Signer authority: we need a short signed statement confirming the signatory for Redwood (name/title) has authority to bind the company on the MSA and Order Form. A one-paragraph PDF is fine.
2) Signing order: Brightwell prefers simultaneous signing but will accept sequential if there are timing constraints. Can you confirm whether Redwood will use a single-envelope simultaneous approach?
3) Clean copies: once the envelope completes, please upload timestamped clean PDFs (one MSA, one Order Form) to the HubSpot deal and share the DocuSign certified copies.

We have the attached redlined PDF for reference (we accepted the commercial redlines; just verifying the execution flow). We are targeting Tuesday Aug 25 for signature.

Attached: Brightwell_MSA_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf

Appreciate the quick confirmation so we can calendar the signing window.

Best,
Lucy

Lucy — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers below and operational plan attached.

1) Signer authority: Redwood signer will be me (Markus Klein, VP Partnerships). Ben and Laura are looped — Ben will trigger the envelope, Laura will validate the final PDFs. I’ll send a brief signed authority statement by EOD.

2) Signing order: We will send a single envelope configured for simultaneous signing (everyone signs the same envelope). That minimizes versioning risks. If Brightwell needs sequential, we can flip the sequencing before sending but simultaneous is our default.

3) Clean copies: After signatures, Ben will download the DocuSign certified copies, verify embedded timestamps, and upload clean PDFs to the HubSpot deal and our contract storage. We’ll also attach the certified .pdf to the HubSpot record and drop the link to the folder in this thread.

Operational notes in the attached run-of-show: who clicks "Sign", the fallback contact if the signer hits an IP verification step, and a short identity checklist for Brightwell to confirm on their side. We expect to send the envelope at 11:00am PT on Tue Aug 25 with a 1-hour signing window.

Attachments: Signing_RunOfShow_20260825.docx

Markus
Markus Klein
VP Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Markus, thanks for the plan. Quick confirmation on two items from our side:

• Authority statement: procurement prefers a signed PDF from the signer plus a brief notarized affirmation is not required. We will accept a scan of the signer's company-signature page plus an emailed authority statement from Markus.

• Identity verification: Brightwell will perform a ID sanity check for external signers. If DocuSign prompts an ID verification step that the signatory can't complete, our backup is procurement desk (procurement@brightwellhealth.com) to approve and countersign.

We’ll be ready at 11:00am PT. Please include the Brightwell procurement inbox on the envelope in case we need to step in.

—James
James O'Keefe
